issue.body:
There is an unaligned atomic field in zapx 15.3.5 which should have been fixed in https://github.com/blevesearch/zapx/pull/147

This bug causes issues on 32bit builds.

Update bleve and zapx to account for this.

Fix #21957

Signed-off-by: Andrew Thornton <art27@cantab.net>
